scope: Late-arriving literature note reviewed for its DKM/KK21/KT and public-code claims. The separate FWSP literature conclusions were not independently re-derived in this addendum.
checks: DKM sampling, calibration, numerical-oracle limitations and corrected stopping order agree with the independently reviewed implementation.
The official purex README names the 2019 DKM paper and Julia 1.1.0; the public code was read but not executed.

Official optimistic_gradient uses log(t), official CTracking uses count-minus-cumulative-weight, and official GK16 threshold is log((1+log(t))/delta); these differ from the printed theorem-setting implementation and are explicitly disclosed.

The note correctly preserves the initial oracle issue, separates the full physical stopping null from the numerical design margin, and requires same-grid/same-certificate controls before attributing performance gains.
